verdicts.why: Seed has 'not happy any more'; 'not' and 'any more' are split by 'happy'.
Seed 'I'd like you to tell me' renders no 'that'; this is a literal gloss of the particle 'que'.
Seed has 'last week'; 'the week' is a literal gloss the translation does not render.
Seed has the contraction 'I'm busy'; 'I'm' is a contiguous substring and still glosses 'je suis'.
Seed has 'didn't know'; the bare 'not' is a literal gloss of 'pas' fused into 'didn't'.
Seed has 'wasn't expecting'; 'not' is a literal gloss of 'pas' fused into 'wasn't'.
Seed has 'shouldn't'; 'not' is a literal gloss of 'pas' fused into the contraction.
Seed 'What do you want me to do?' has no 'that'; this is a literal gloss of 'que'.
Seed has 'wouldn't like'; 'I'd like' is not in the sentence and the forced value is not unique.
Seed has 'didn't know'; 'knew' is a different inflection of 'know'.
Seed has 'would happen'; 'that it' is a literal gloss of 'qu'il' that the translation does not render.
Seed has 'next week'; 'the week' is a literal gloss the translation does not render.
Seed has 'of course'; 'good' is a literal gloss of 'bien' that the translation does not render.
Seed has 'doing worse'; 'less' is a literal gloss of 'moins' that the translation does not render.
Seed has 'This was where'; 'there' is a literal gloss of 'là' that is not rendered.
Seed has 'for helping'; 'me' is a literal gloss of 'm'avoir' that the translation drops.
Seed has 'you don't mind'; 'it' is a literal gloss of 'ça' that is not rendered.
Seed has 'tonight'; the LEGO 'ce soir-là' differs from the seed's 'ce soir', so the LEGO disagrees with the seed.
Seed 'An interesting book' interposes 'interesting' between 'a(n)' and 'book'.
Seed has 'can't remember'; 'not' is a literal gloss of 'pas' fused into the contraction.
